level.description: Three halls in a row along +X, enclosed by walls. The player starts at (0, 0).

invariants.description: The player pawn must never fall out of the world: die, drop below KillZ, or end up more than 2 m below the floor (Z < -200), except through a region the design marks as intentional. A fall anywhere else is a level geometry bug.
Interacting with Door1 while standing within 150 cm of it must open the door. If the door is still not open after a later step, the interaction is broken.
Interacting with Door2 while standing within 150 cm of it must open the door. If the door is still not open after a later step, the interaction is broken.
Collecting Pickup1 (it disappears from the world) must increase InventoryCount. If it is gone but the count is unchanged since it was last present, the pickup was lost.

intentional.description: The visible open pit in the middle hall is an intentional hazard; falling into it is expected. The region is the 200x200 cm pit plus a 50 cm capsule-radius margin.
